ruling.recommended_action: Issue a Ryde voucher of $11.65 to the rider (refund of the metered distance component for the two unexempted off-route segments: 4.787 km extra — clockwise Marine Parade loop 3.023 km + Sentosa Gateway backtrack 1.764 km — at $2.433/km); no account flag (driver's route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so RD-6 is not triggered).

segment_findings.reason: GPS departs the quoted route at ~18:31:40 (1.2802,103.8400) and runs NNE via the Bedok/Marine Parade roads to ~18:34:40 (1.2894,103.8335), returning SW to the same node at ~18:36:40 — a ~3.023 km backtrack. No traffic incident on the optimal route (traffic.incidents empty), only band-3 speed records (RD-4(b) is corroborative only and band 3 is not the band-1/2 proxy), so RD-4 does not exempt it. The driver's route-change question (18:28:50) post-dates the start of the deviation and the rider never agreed, so RD-5 does not apply. Unexempted under RD-1/RD-2.

GPS at ~18:38:10 (1.2802,103.8302) reverses and runs NE to ~18:39:40 (1.2764,103.8332) then back SW to (1.2761,103.8311), a ~1.764 km V-shaped detour before rejoining the Sentosa approach. No incident and no band-1/2 congestion on the substituted optimal segment (RD-4), and no prior rider consent in the chat (RD-5); the driver's statement that the rider did not object is post-hoc and unconsented. Unexempted under RD-1/RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver cited building traffic on Kampong Bahru Road, but Kampong Bahru Road is the quoted optimal route itself, the substituted segments carry no LTA incident and only band-3 speed records; the record does not corroborate a 'reasonable cause' under RD-4.

Driver says 'no objection, so I took it'; RD-5 requires affirmative rider agreement before the deviation begins. The only chat message (18:28:50) post-dates segment (a)'s start and the rider never replied.
